|translation='''Title:''' Imperial Walker.

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot and eight passengers. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:''' Four-legged enclosed combat vehicle. The looming AT-AT (All Terrain Armored Transport) can carry an entire battalion of fully armed soldiers.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says battalion where the English lore says squadron.
|notes='''Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Imperial Walker|Imperial Walker]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Imperial Walker (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R49 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R49.
